name: World of Pannotia: Mini Blocks
summary: Shrinks common building blocks into decorative "Mini" blocks. In a stonecutter, one full block makes 8 Mini blocks, which are custom-skinned player heads you can place as small decorations.

new_content.name: Mini blocks (204 variants)
new_content.how_to_obtain: Put the full block in a Stonecutter; each recipe produces 8 player heads named "Mini <Block>" (rarity common) with a custom skin texture of the block. The recipe unlocks in the recipe book when the input block is in your inventory.
new_content.notes: Placed like any player head (on the ground or on walls); breaking one keeps its data. mechanics.title: Lit and unlit variants
mechanics.description: Each copper bulb (plain, exposed, weathered, oxidized) has a Lit and an unlit Mini variant from the same input block; Redstone Lamp has Lit and Unlit variants.

mechanics.title: Recipe unlock
mechanics.description: Each recipe has an advancement that grants it once the input block enters your inventory.

vanilla_changes.change: 204 new stonecutting recipes: 1 of the listed block -> 8 Mini player heads.

getting_started: Place a Stonecutter, put a block such as Stone or Oak Planks in it, and take 8 Mini heads from the output.
editor_notes: Coral entries use the coral block as input; Hay Bale uses hay_block; Wool uses white wool only. Verify the skin textures in game.
